messages:
Kai: Hey folks — I'm starting Monday as a short-term contractor on infra. Quick q: do contractors get loaner laptops or should I enroll my personal Mac? Also what's the timeline for the mandatory security training and the phishing simulation? I want to get ahead of it.

Leila (people-ops): Welcome Kai! We generally issue a loaner for contractors unless there's a strong reason to use a personal device. I'll loop in IT. You'll need to complete the 'SecureStart' training within 5 days of your account activation. The phishing simulation runs monthly; new joiners are included in the next run by default.

Priya (it-support): Hi Kai — we can ship a loaner. Please fill the device request form: https://redwood.example.com/internal/device-request?team=infra. If you plan to use your personal Mac instead, it must be enrolled in MDM and have FileVault enabled. To check FileVault, run: `fdesetup status` — it should say 'FileVault is On'.

Sam (security): Small add: contractors are required to complete SecureStart + the 10-min phishing micro-course. We don't grant blanket exemptions from sims, but we can give a one-time "new-joiner grace" so the first sim won't count toward security scoring. @Leila, can you flag that for this user?

Leila (people-ops): @Sam yes, I'll flag it. Kai — do you already have a Redwood VPN account? If not I'll raise it and provision credentials.

Kai: I don't have VPN or laptop yet. I submitted the device request form just now (thanks). I'm remote in NZ so Thurs 3pm PT live drop-in is awkward for me — is there a recorded session or an alternate slot? :wave:

Priya (it-support): For folks outside the Americas we keep recordings and offer a 1:1 onboarding slot. Once the loaner ships you'll get FedEx tracking and a QR for MDM enrollment. Quick enrollment steps we use:
1) open https://mdm.redwood.example/enroll
2) scan QR from the shipping email or open link on the device
3) install the management profile and give permissions
4) reboot if prompted
If the admin console shows 'enrollment pending', wait ~5 minutes and then reconnect to wifi.

Leila (people-ops): Thanks — I'll create the VPN account now and set the training due date to 5 days after your account activation. @onboard-bot can you tag this thread 'contractor-device-request' and set a reminder in 3 days?

onboard-bot: Reminder created: contractor-device-request — 3d. IT will confirm stock and shipping once they pick the request up.

Kai: Amazing, thanks everyone. One last q — are contractors required to use the company-managed password vault? I use 1Password personally; happy to create a company vault if needed.

Sam (security): Yes, we require company credential segregation. Please request a 1Password SCIM invite (team vault) — email security@redwood.example.com if you need an expedited invite.

Leila (people-ops): Closing the loop here: VPN ticket #4527 created, SecureStart training due date set to +5 days from account activation, loaner request submitted to IT. If the loaner hasn't shipped by Wednesday before start, ping me and I'll escalate. Welcome aboard! :tada:
